I did not find a separate stroke or post-stroke dementia code.

### Codes you may want to add, depending on your study

| Code | Term | Why it's borderline |
|:--|:--|:--|
| ^ESCTVA751506 | Vascular dementia in remission | It confirms a diagnosis, but "remission" doesn't fit with having the condition now |
| ^ESCTMI802420 | Mixed dementia | The cause isn't specified, though it usually means Alzheimer's plus vascular dementia |
| ^ESCT1237064 / ^ESCT1237066 | Dementia with mixed etiology / aetiology | Same reason: the cause isn't specified |

### Codes left out
- **Too general:** ^ESCT1169441 "Subcortical dementia". It can also be caused by Parkinson's or Huntington's disease.
- **Not dementia codes:** ^ESCTWH786117 "White matter disorder with CADASIL" (CADASIL is an inherited small-vessel disease); multi-infarct state; multiple / lacunar infarcts.
- **Other dementia types:** Alzheimer's disease codes (Eu00 / F00), including the "atypical or mixed type" codes (Eu002, F002x), and unspecified dementia codes (F03).

### Notes
- **Binswanger's disease (F21y2):** I included it because ICD-10 counts it as subcortical vascular dementia (F01.2). Leave it out if you only want explicit dementia diagnoses.
- **Mixed Alzheimer's/vascular dementia (MVAD):** this is included. Leave it out if you want vascular dementia on its own.
